title: ClockRecord v1 — the clock watch's judgement of one act: accepted, or refused by named reason and counted apart — unknown_node, unknown_observer, duplicate_node, mesh_full, self_observation, stale_sequence, duplicate_sequence, malformed_sample, malformed_beat, uncorroborated, severely_skewed; an accepted observe carries the measured skew_seconds (the node's claimed time minus the observer's receipt time), an accepted judge carries corrected_at (the claimed time corrected by the node's corroborated median skew) — names, counts, and times only, never payload content (Y-068)
